title: Mangyan literacy program in Oriental Mindoro wins 2026 Galing Pook Award

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Zero Illiteracy and Innumeracy Program for Mangyan communities in Oriental Mindoro was among 10 local governance initiatives recognized by the 2026 Galing Pook Awards, which honor innovative programs that improve lives in local communities. The recognition puts a spotlight on Oriental Mindoro’s efforts to expand educational opportunities for Mangyan communities by drawing on local knowledge, cultural understanding and community participation.
